summary: John's 2nd great-grandmother; widowed in 1899 with ten children, remarried John H. Jones.
bio: Catherine A. Murphy was born 27 Apr 1860 in Plymouth and died there 4 Apr 1931; buried Larksville (FS K6NQ-ZX8). Widowed by William R. McAvoy's death in 1899, she married (2) John H. Jones; her daughter Elizabeth lived in his household in 1920. The 1923 licence calls her 'Kathryn Murphy, Plymouth, b. Penna'.
